in_marathi.name: Idhaya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Idhaya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Idhaya is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘idam’, meaning ‘this’. It signifies a divine gift, a blessing from the gods. In Hindu mythology, Idhaya is believed to represent the divine feminine and is associated with grace, compassion, and nourishment.
